data.narrative:
Velaura AI is a Series C semiconductor company founded by Rajiv Khemani, Barun Kar, Saptadeep Pal, and Patrick Xu, having raised $343M to date. The valuation framework draws from a peer universe of 3 public semiconductor comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private-stage peers in Chips & Semiconductors, including Tenstorrent, Positron AI, and DEEPX.

Two triangulation methods proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $343M total raised as a baseline proxy and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, implied a valuation of $583M. Peer-median benchmarking across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yielded a $1.0B implied value, with the peer set ranging from $529M (DEEPX, Series C) to $2.7B (Tenstorrent, Series D). Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples could not be applied due to the absence of revenue disclosure for the target.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $496M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $792M. Key uncertainties include the company's unreported revenue trajectory, competitive positioning within the AI-infrastructure semiconductor segment, and the appropriate weighting between stage-typical multiples and peer market settlements. The wide peer range ($529M–$2.7B) reflects heterogeneity in this emerging sector and underscores sensitivity to company-specific differentiation.
